channel.title: The Smithfield Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Smithfield Times (smithfieldtimes.com)

item.title: Wallpaper Picks for Smithfield Homes That Offer Historic Charm but Modern Ease
item.description: The tree-lined streets and historic buildings make up Smithfield, which provides homeowners with the unique possibility to combine old and new comfort.

item.title: IW School Board calls Feb. 26 meeting on proposed 2026-27 budget
item.description: Isle of Wight County's School Board will take its first look at Superintendent Theo Cramer's proposed 2026-27 budget on Feb. 26.

item.title: Planning commissioner wants ban on battery storage
item.description: An Isle of Wight County planning commissioner says she wants to ban battery storage projects as the county weighs new rules that would allow and regulate them.

item.title: Surry School Board to hold Feb. 24 budget hearing
item.description: Surry's School Board will hold a Feb. 24 public hearing on a 2026-27 budget proposal, which seeks a roughly 4% increase in local funding from the county.

item.title: Hunt club rejected for land lease alleges unfair treatment by IW EDA
item.description: Farmers Hunt Club alleges Isle of Wight’s Economic Development Authority unfairly used its $20,000 offer to shape a counterproposal that kept a 703-acre hunting lease with Marshall Hunt Club. Economic Development officials deny sharing Farmers' bid with Marshall.

item.title: Judge awards IW Sheriff’s Office custody of nine dogs left in ice storm
item.description: A judge granted the Isle of Wight Sheriff’s Office custody of nine dogs left outside in an ice storm and barred the former owners from possessing companion animals.

item.title: IW supervisors postpone vote on five-year comprehensive plan update
item.description: Isle of Wight supervisors delayed their decision on a proposed five-year update to the “Envisioning the Isle” comprehensive plan, and will revisit the matter at a March 5 work session.

item.title: Carolyn Martin Gleason
item.description: Carolyn Martin Gleason, 90, of Hertford, NC, passed away on Saturday, February 21, 2026

item.title: Aircraft carrier jet fuel spill didn’t reach IW, Surry
item.description: A 4,700-gallon jet fuel spill on the James River avoided Isle of Wight and Surry counties.

item.title: Practical Lifestyle Picks for Beach Season and Everyday Ease
item.description: Beach season often encourages a reassessment of comfort and simplicity.
